products.name: Code.org
products.note: Verified in the research for The AI Ready School. AI: AI Lab features not verified. Use: Computer science courses and AI lessons. Who: Students K to 12, teachers. Student age: Designed for all ages; under 13 with school, teacher, or parent pre-authorization; teacher-created alias accounts; sharing limited under 13. Privacy: Student Privacy Pledge signatory; districts can sign Code.org's student data privacy addendum online, with state versions for New York, Illinois, and Montana. Price: Free.
